method: Located all 17 supplied PDFs after the requested desktop folder was no longer present and copied them into a preserved intake working set before analysis.
Verified SHA-256, byte size, PDF readability and actual page count for every file and every page.
Read embedded text from every page, OCR-processed all 700 sparse-text pages, and rendered all 1,280 pages into sequence-preserving visual fingerprints.
Visually inspected the five pages that remained sparse after extraction: three legitimate SRF attachment dividers, one City of Novi site map and one Cadillac council-packet aerial image.
Compared byte hashes, normalized text, page counts, rendered-page sequences and perceptual page fingerprints against 2,593 prior audited records before duplicate or scope classification.

exactExistingRecords.name: Effluent.pdf

duplicateResolution.basis: The two supplied filenames are byte-identical to each other. Their normalized text and all 16 rendered pages are identical to the existing byte-different June 2026 DMR, so the established record is reused. PDF page 15 was visually rechecked and preserves the cyanide and CBOD value comments.
